name: St. John of Damascus, Tyler, TX
description: Local customizations for St. John of Damascus Orthodox Church, Tyler, TX (OCA). Layered through the OCA jurisdiction default (oca → sts-sluzhebnik → base) — only parish-specific deltas live in liturgy-fixed.json here.

temple._note: Patron saint of the temple. The assembler appends the patron troparion at the end of the troparia list, and the kontakion before the principal-feast kontakion with a 'Glory…' connector. Sourced from menaion DB by commemorationId.
temple.title: Venerable John of Damascus

preCommunion._note: Parish sings the Communion Prayer ('I believe, O Lord, and I confess...') BEFORE the priest's 'In the fear of God, with faith, and with love, draw near!' and the choir's 'Blessed is He that comes...'. HTM/Jordanville-influenced order; diverges from the strict OCA Service Book which has them inverted.
